eps.t: Reincarnated as a Sidekick Character in an Eroge, but I'll Use My Game Knowledge to Do What I Want
eps.ov: Takioto Kousuke is reincarnated into his favorite eroge, Magical Explorer, but as the unlucky sidekick?!

eps.t: Greetings from the Land of the Elves
eps.ov: Kousuke barely saves Ludie from an attack by the Church of the Malevolent God, so he vows to get stronger.
Kousuke asks Mizumori Yukine to train him so he can learn the Mind's Eye skill.
In order to get stronger faster, Kousuke enters the solo dungeon "Twilight Cavern" to find Nanami.
Kousuke and Iori are late on their first day at Tsukuyomi Magic Academy and Kousuke ends up in a mock battle?!
Kousuke's team is so strong that they have to go for a special dungeons called the Carplin Castle.
Kousuke and Nanami go to the Night Sky Cave to acquire a new skill, but they find a weird, extra floor?
Kousuke gets caught by Ruija-sensei and is forced to participate in a weird experiment...

eps.t: One of the Big Three, Mizumori Yukine
eps.ov: Kousuke tries to help Yukine overcome her inferiority complex she has about her sister Suzune.
